summary: alipclutch-baileys ships char-code-obfuscated network host in messages-send path
details: This package is a fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library. lib/Socket/messages-send.js contains a network host string reconstructed at runtime from a String.fromCharCode(...) byte array, which decodes to https://fiora.nixel.my.id/. The destination is embedded in the message-send code path and its hostname is deliberately hidden from plain-text search by the char-code encoding, rather than declared as a configurable option. Obfuscated reconstruction of a hardcoded non-first-party endpoint inside the message-send flow of a WhatsApp session library is consistent with covert relay or exfiltration of session-derived data through the consumer's authenticated WhatsApp connection. The package name also imitates the popular Baileys library, which increases the likelihood of unintended installation.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
